question: Can a versioned manifest identity contract make B01/B02 semantic scene structure exact while separately retaining exact fork product provenance, without changing SceneSpec, BuildPlan, product source, OCIO, fixtures or F0.4 acceptance criteria?
hypothesis: The attempt-02 mismatch is caused only by mixing runtime provenance into semantic scene structure. Moving the Blender version/build identity to the already existing execution provenance layer will restore deterministic semantic hashes while preserving strict product identity checks.

protocolJustification.historicalIntent: The preregistered B13 protocol states that Blender version/build identity belongs outside the structure object so semantic structure hashes remain stable.
protocolJustification.attempt02Observation: Removing $.blender from the B01 structure leaves all scene semantics exact; the full observed diff had one path, $.blender.buildHash.
protocolJustification.notAThresholdRelaxation: Semantic structure remains byte-exact and product provenance remains exact; each receives its own independently attacked identity gate.

compiler: Remove the blender runtime object from the semantic structure object.
Keep exact Blender version/build/branch/platform in manifest.execution.blender.
Store the semantic structure hash in scene bfs_structure_hash and exact product build hash in scene bfs_product_build_hash.
authorizedChanges.auditHarness: Add independent semantic/provenance checks and two separation attacks.

forbiddenChanges: Do not alter the embedded contract implementation or canonical BuildPlan bytes.
Do not alter Blender source commit b47eae224b6d3e71559b55df85fd20ae87d3f92b or rebuild the product.
Do not alter B01/B02 SceneSpec, BuildPlan, asset, render or OCIO bytes.
Do not overwrite attempt-01 or attempt-02 evidence.
acceptance: Attempt-01 canonical BuildPlan, negative-control and approval-order evidence remains byte-bound and PASS.
B01 and B02 each build once in distinct absent-before-run roots using exact OCIO and the corrected compiler frozen after this preregistration.
Each manifest reports version 0.3.0, the frozen semantic hash and exact product provenance; each .blend stores both identities.
Independent audit imports neither compiler nor contract runner and verifies both .blend files, receipts and prior failures.
A provenance mutation fails only provenance identity; a semantic mutation fails only semantic identity.
Official Blender configuration remains exact, concurrency is one, every product start retains 160 GiB free and no more than three product starts occur.
stopRules: If admission, any frozen input hash, source/product identity or target absence check fails, record BLOCKED and start no product process.
If B01, B02 or the independent audit fails after formal start, preserve evidence and record FAIL without same-ID repair.
Do not change the preregistered expected semantic hashes after observing formal output.
claimCeiling: A PASS can close F0.4 only by combining attempt-01 contract/negative/approval evidence with attempt-03 B01/B02 construction and independent identity audit. It cannot erase either retained failure or prove F0.5-F0.7.
